question: 整机的BOM所有子件及单台总用量是多少？
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree(parent_id, child_id, total_qty, level) AS (SELECT b.parent_material_id, b.child_material_id, b.qty_per_parent, 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.parent_material_id = 'FG001' UNION ALL SELECT bt.child_id, b.child_material_id, bt.total_qty * b.qty_per_parent, bt.level + 1 FROM bom_tree bt JOIN bom b ON b.parent_material_id = bt.child_id) SELECT bt.child_id AS material_id, m.material_name, ROUND(SUM(bt.total_qty), 4) AS total_qty, MIN(bt.level) AS first_level FROM bom_tree bt JOIN material m ON m.material_id = bt.child_id GROUP BY bt.child_id, m.material_name ORDER BY first_level, bt.child_id
